description:
About us: 
 At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.

 

 Position Overview: 

 The Salesforce Developer owns Fullbay’s Salesforce platform end to end, from day-to-day administration and configuration through custom Apex and Lightning Web Component development. This role determines when a requirement calls for declarative configuration and when it calls for code, then builds the solution directly. Working closely with Sales, Finance, and Operations stakeholders across Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, and the Nue CPQ platform and its integrations with QuickBooks and Stripe, the Salesforce Developer is accountable for both the daily health of the platform and its long-term technical architecture.

 

 Right Wrench for the Job: 

 The right wrench for this job enjoys the full spectrum of Salesforce work, from resolving a user’s support request in the morning to delivering a custom Apex integration in the afternoon. This individual takes ownership of both the daily health of the platform and its long-term architecture, builds solutions that scale, and partners with Sales, Finance, and Operations to understand the business need before building.

 

 Primary Duties & Responsibilities: 

 
   Platform Ownership & Administration 
 
 Own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and health of the Salesforce platform across Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, and Nue CPQ 

 Debug and resolve production issues in a timely manner across both configuration and code 

 Manage sandbox environments and CI/CD / change-set deployment processes 

 


   Development & Engineering 
 
 Design and develop custom Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, and scheduled jobs 
 

 Build and maintain Lightning Web Components (LWC) for custom UI experiences 

   Develop and maintain REST/SOAP API integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems (QuickBooks, Stripe, Nue CPQ) 

 Write clean, well-documented, testable code with a minimum of 85% code coverage 

 Determine whether a given requirement is best solved with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules) or custom code, and build accordingly 

 


 Project Delivery & Architecture 
 
 Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions 

   Build and deploy Flows, validation rules, custom objects, fields, and page layouts 

 Ensure solutions are scalable, governor-limit compliant, and built for long-term maintainability 

 Document configurations, technical designs, data models, and integration specifications for ongoing maintainability 

 Participate in sprint planning and project intake prioritization with RevOps leadership 

 


 Consulting & Strategy 
 
 Proactively identify and recommend improvements to existing processes and data models 

   Partner with Revenue Operations to align Salesforce capabilities to business goals 

 Stay current on Salesforce releases, Einstein AI features, developer tools, and platform updates; evaluate and implement relevant new functionality 

 


   General 
 
 Adheres to all confidentiality, compliance, and company standards 

 Performs other duties as assigned

 

 


 
 Minimum Education & Work Experience: 

 
   7+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration / development experience, including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce data model design 

 1 year of AI experience and switching processes over to using AI 

 Strong proficiency with Salesforce Flow (Screen Flows, Record-Triggered Flows, and Scheduled Flows) 

 Experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC) and an understanding of the Lightning component framework 

 Experience with Sales Cloud, including opportunity management, lead routing, and forecasting 

 Experience building and maintaining REST or SOAP API integrations 

 Deep understanding of Salesforce governor limits, bulkification, and asynchronous processing patterns 

 Demonstrated ability to manage projects end to end, from requirements through deployment 

 At least 2 active Salesforce certifications spanning both the administrator and developer tracks, with preference for: 
 
   Salesforce Certified Administrator 

    Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I 

   Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator 

 Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II 

 Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant 

 Salesforce Certified Integration Architecture Designer 

 Agentforce Specialist 

 


 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Experience with CPQ tools (Nue, Salesforce CPQ, or similar) and order-to-cash / quote-to-cash workflows 

 Familiarity with QuickBooks and/or Stripe integrations and APIs 

 Experience with Einstein AI features, including Einstein Copilot, Lead Scoring, or Opportunity Insights 

 Knowledge of Agentforce or generative AI tooling within the Salesforce ecosystem 

 Experience with Salesforce DX (SFDX), scratch orgs, and CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset) 

 Exposure to platform events, Change Data Capture (CDC), or the Salesforce streaming API 

 Experience working in a SaaS or subscription-based business model

 

 


 
 Key Skills and Qualifications: 

 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders 

 Sound judgment in choosing between declarative configuration and custom code, and the ability to build either 

 Strong requirements-gathering and project management skills, from intake through deployment 

 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including diagnosing production issues across configuration and code 

 Commitment to clean, documented, testable, and maintainable work 

 Consultative mindset, with the initiative to recommend improvements to existing processes and data models

 

 
 Physical Demands and Work Environment: 

 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions 

 
 Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.  

 Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening. 

 Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.    

 Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. 

 Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.
